meta.title: Certificate lookup
meta.description: Verify certificates issued by WinDe Exam with a lookup code, and browse recently issued certificates.

codeMeta.title: Certificate verification
codeMeta.description: Check whether a WinDe Exam certificate is valid using the code printed on it.

verify.title: Certificate lookup
verify.subtitle: Enter the code printed on the certificate to verify it.
verify.hint: The lookup code is printed along the bottom edge of the certificate, in the form EXAM-2026-XXXXXX.

VALID.heading: Valid certificate
VALID.message: This certificate was issued by our system and is currently valid.

REVOKED.heading: Certificate revoked
REVOKED.message: This certificate was issued but has since been revoked and is no longer valid.

EXPIRED.heading: Certificate expired
EXPIRED.message: This certificate has passed its validity period.

NOT_FOUND.heading: Certificate not found
NOT_FOUND.message: No certificate matches this code. Please double-check the lookup code.

wall.title: Issued certificates
wall.summary: {total, plural, one {# valid certificate} other {# valid certificates}} issued by WinDe Exam, newest first.
wall.summaryEmpty: Valid certificates issued by WinDe Exam.
wall.empty: No certificates have been issued yet.
